subject: Code review: Changes requested for AMSD-2041

body.text: Code review identified issues that need to be addressed.

issues.description: ContentstackProvider is never mounted anywhere in the application. Codegraph query for 'ContentstackProvider' returned no results. All 20+ existing consumers (tests and components) use ContentstackContext.Provider directly (e.g., Header.spec.tsx, Footer.spec.tsx, Layout.spec.tsx, NewsListingContainer.spec.tsx, etc.). The new provider with its live-preview subscription logic is dead code — the onEntryChange subscription never runs, so none of the 7 acceptance criteria are met. The RCA explicitly states 'ContentstackProvider is the single source of content truth for the entire app — all 236+ components access content via useContent → useContentstackContext → ContentstackContext', but the diff introduces a new wrapper that nothing wraps with.
issues.suggestedFix: Either (a) wire ContentstackProvider into the app's root layout (_app.tsx or equivalent) so it wraps the entire component tree, replacing the raw ContentstackContext.Provider usage, or (b) integrate the live-preview subscription logic directly into the existing context setup that components already consume, rather than creating a new unused Provider component.

issues.description: The onEntryChange callback discards the entry data from the SDK. The implementation is `LivePreview.onEntryChange(() => { setPreviewOverrides((prev) => ({ ...prev })); })` — it spreads the previous (always empty) state into a new object and ignores the callback parameter. The Contentstack Live Preview SDK's onEntryChange callback receives the updated entry data as an argument; this implementation never captures it. Even if ContentstackProvider were mounted, previewOverrides would always be {}.
issues.suggestedFix: Capture the entry data from the callback: `LivePreview.onEntryChange((entry) => { setPreviewOverrides(entry); })` or merge it appropriately. The callback parameter contains the draft entry content that must be stored in state.

issues.description: Override key mismatch: useContent looks up overrides by the dotted path string (e.g., 'page.0.page_components.0.Attention_Block.attention_block_heading'), but the Contentstack Live Preview SDK provides structured entry data (the full entry object), not a flat map of dotted-path keys to values. The hasOwnProperty check against livePreview[path] will never match because the SDK does not produce a flat dotted-path-keyed dictionary. This means even with correct onEntryChange data capture, no override would ever be found.
issues.suggestedFix: Either (a) flatten the SDK's entry data into a dotted-path map before storing in previewOverrides, or (b) change the lookup to traverse the structured entry data using the path. Reuse the existing getValue utility for the traversal: `getValue(livePreview, path, getValue(content, path, defaultValue))`.

issues.description: No server-side Contentstack Stack configuration. The RCA explicitly prescribes: 'the server-side Contentstack Stack initialization must be configured with live_preview: { enable: true, preview_token: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_TOKEN, host: process.env.CONTENTSTACK_PREVIEW_HOST } so that preview queries return draft content.' This is entirely absent from the diff. Without it, the SDK cannot fetch draft content, so onEntryChange would never deliver preview data even if the callback were correct.
issues.suggestedFix: Locate the Contentstack Stack initialization (likely in cx-shared or an API util) and add the live_preview configuration with enable, preview_token, and host from environment variables. Use named constants from src/config/constants.ts for the env var names.

issues.description: No unit tests for ContentstackProvider. The diff adds a new React component with useEffect, dynamic import, and state management, but no test file exists for it. The resolve_test_file tool and grep found no test file at test/unit/context/ or co-located __tests__/. Per review criteria, new features must have corresponding vitest unit tests mirroring the src/ path. The ContentstackLink.spec.ts tests only verify the link component with manually-mocked context values — they do not test the provider's subscription lifecycle, onEntryChange wiring, or graceful degradation when the SDK is unavailable.
issues.suggestedFix: Add a test file (e.g., src/context/__tests__/contentstackContext.spec.tsx) that verifies: (1) ContentstackProvider renders children, (2) onEntryChange is called when preview URL params are present, (3) state updates propagate to consumers, (4) graceful fallback when SDK import fails, (5) no subscription when preview params absent (production).

issues.description: useEffect cleanup does not unsubscribe from onEntryChange. The cleanup sets `cancelled = true` but never calls the SDK's unsubscribe/cleanup method. If ContentstackProvider unmounts and remounts (e.g., route changes in Next.js), multiple onEntryChange listeners accumulate, causing duplicate state updates and potential memory leaks. The @contentstack/live-preview-utils SDK typically returns an unsubscribe function from onEntryChange or provides an onEntryChange cleanup method.
issues.suggestedFix: Capture the return value of LivePreview.onEntryChange() (if it returns an unsubscribe function) and call it in the useEffect cleanup, or call LivePreview.unsubscribe()/LivePreview.cleanup() if available.

issues.description: Hardcoded query parameter strings. 'live_preview', 'entry_uid', 'content_type_uid' are hardcoded string literals. Per review criteria (criterion 6), no hardcoded strings — all should use named constants from src/config/constants.ts.
issues.suggestedFix: Define constants like LIVE_PREVIEW_PARAM, ENTRY_UID_PARAM, CONTENT_TYPE_UID_PARAM in src/config/constants.ts and import them.

issues.description: Silent .catch(() => {}) swallows all errors with no logging. While graceful degradation is intended, this masks real configuration errors (e.g., SDK installed but misconfigured) during development. The RCA states 'SDK not installed or initialisation failed; fall back gracefully' but silent failure makes debugging impossible.
issues.suggestedFix: At minimum, log a warning in development: `.catch((err) => { if (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') console.warn('Live Preview SDK init failed:', err); })`.

issues.description: Unsafe type assertion `livePreview[path] as T` bypasses TypeScript's type safety. The value from the override bag is `unknown` (from Record<string, unknown>), and casting it directly to T without validation could introduce runtime type errors if the SDK delivers data in an unexpected shape. This violates TypeScript strict compliance criteria.
issues.suggestedFix: Either validate the shape before casting, or use a type guard, or at minimum add an explanatory comment per the review criteria ('no untyped any without an explanatory comment' — the same principle applies to unsafe casts).

issues.description: The added comment block (lines 20-22) is explanatory but redundant — it describes mechanism (how live preview works) rather than intent. The code is self-documenting via the getContentByKey call. This adds 3 lines of comment to a 25-line component.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove the comment or reduce to a single line if any clarification is needed.

issues.description: Listed as a relevant file in the review task but has no changes in the diff. The file defines IContentCard and IContentCardsList interfaces. If card reordering (acceptance criterion 7) requires changes to how card lists are consumed or rendered, the interface may need a live-preview-aware accessor, but since the root cause is in the provider/hook layer, no changes here may be needed. Confirm this file was listed in error or if changes were intended.
issues.suggestedFix: No action needed if the provider-level fix correctly propagates card list changes. Remove from relevant files list if no changes were planned.
